responsibility: This file defines the m68k backend’s RTL operand predicates used by instruction recognition and expander conditions. It specializes generic operand classes for pc-relative memory forms, symbolic call and sibcall addresses, 32-bit constant ranges in larger modes, ColdFire comparison restrictions, floating-point constant acceptability, addq/subq immediates, stack addressing forms, and various branch or peephole helpers. These predicates are included by m68k.md and drive which RTL forms match particular m68k instruction patterns.
